2607.15047.title: Parameter-efficient Prompt Tuning of Vision Foundation Model With Adaptive Focal Loss for Interpretable MCI Screening
2607.15047.paper_summary: Mild Cognitive Impairment is a critical early stage of cognitive decline that frequently precedes Alzheimer's disease, yet its automated detection from neuropsychological drawing tests remains fundamentally constrained by data scarcity, class imbalance, and diagnostic ambiguity near clinical boundaries. Existing methodologies attempt to bypass these constraints using computationally expensive, fully fine-tuned hybrid architectures that relegate spatial explainability to a post-hoc approximation rather than an intrinsic model property. We propose a parameter-efficient framework utilizing frozen DINOv2-Small model adapted via three modality-specific learnable prompt tokens while Operating with 1.19 million trainable parameters, each token serves as a query in a shared cross-attention layer over the source image patch tokens. Crucially, spatial explainability is achieved directly through these attention maps; as a structural consequence of the architecture. Then task-conditioned embeddings fused via an attention module to quantify modality-level importance per subject. To handle boundary ambiguity, a MoCA-adapted focal loss introduced that integrates continuous cognitive scores into the training target, loss modulation, and adaptive sample weighting, strictly generalizing standard soft-label approaches. Under stratified five-fold cross-validation, the proposed architecture yields an MCI-class F1 of 0.641 and an AUC of 0.795, outperforming the computationally heavier ResViT baseline by 0.110 in MCI-class F1.
2607.15047.paper_summary_zh: 輕度認知障礙是認知衰退的一個關鍵早期階段，經常在阿茲海默症之前出現，然而，從神經心理學繪圖測試中自動檢測其仍然受到數據稀缺、類別不平衡和臨床邊界附近診斷模糊性的基本限制。現有的方法試圖通過使用計算成本高昂的完全微調混合架構來繞過這些限制，這些架構將空間可解釋性 relegated 為事後近似，而不是內在模型屬性。我們提出了一個參數高效的框架，利用經過三種特定模態可學習提示標記調整的凍結 DINOv2-Small 模型，並在 119 萬可訓練參數下運行，每個標記作為共享交叉注意力層中的查詢，針對源圖像補丁標記。至關重要的是，空間可解釋性通過這些注意力圖直接實現；作為架構的結構性結果。然後通過注意力模塊融合任務條件嵌入，以量化每個主體的模態級重要性。為了處理邊界模糊性，引入了一種 MoCA 調整的焦點損失，將連續的認知分數整合到訓練目標、損失調整和自適應樣本加權中，嚴格地概括了標準軟標籤方法。在分層五折交叉驗證下，所提出的架構在 MCI 類別上產生了 0.641 的 F1 值和 0.795 的 AUC，並在 MCI 類別 F1 上超越了計算成本更高的 ResViT 基準 0.110。
